events.title: Marriages
events.description: Married (1) Hannah Saxton in Huntington, 1730; (2) Anna, daughter of Job Smith 2d and widow of Ebenezer Smith. Large tracts laid out to him 1736; homestead at Sunk Meadow, Smithtown. [R4-S1]

bio:
Zephaniah Platt was born in 1704, the son of Jonas Platt, who was born in 1684 and drowned at Amboy in 1731, and a grandson of Captain Epenetus Platt of Huntington. He married at Huntington, NY, about 1730. By his wife Hannah Saxton he had Jonas, Zephaniah, Nathaniel, Charles, Hannah and Elizabeth; by his second wife, Anna Smith, he had Jeremiah, Daniel, Sarah and Dorothea. He is connected to John's family by marriage, as stepfather of Anna's children by her Smith husband. He died in 1778.

He should not be confused with Zephaniah Platt (1735–1807), the founder of Plattsburgh: that man was his son by Hannah Saxton.
